claim_scope: A single exploratory predictive-piece test on the frozen 20-member Binance USD-M panel; not a causal, trading, strategy-family, Router, or Qnty claim.
breadth_boundary: SEALED_OBSERVATION_ACTIVE; SEALED_T0=2026-08-10T19:00:00Z; no protected Breadth forward outcome may be accessed.

feature.member_eligibility: A member contributes exactly when its canonical Binance USD-M materializer has a valid publisher-checksummed archive event, an exact funding_time_ms, a finite canonical funding_rate, and the latest event satisfies decision_time-24h < funding_time <= decision_time. No current-listing substitution.
feature.settlement_timestamp_semantics: Use the source funding_time_ms exactly; never round, snap, infer, or replace it with an expected cadence.
feature.known_at_semantics: A finalized public settlement event is known at its exact funding_time_ms. At a daily 00:00:00Z decision, use only events with funding_time_ms <= decision_time.
feature.funding_sign_convention: Positive funding_rate means longs pay shorts; negative means shorts pay longs. Sign is retained in source data but the frozen pressure transform is absolute magnitude.
feature.lookback_aggregation_horizon: Most recent eligible settlement per member, with a maximum 24-hour event age; no multi-event accumulation.

normalization.cdf_formula: CDF365(current) = count(v <= current) / count(v), where v is the 365 prior daily observations plus current
normalization.tie_semantics: inclusive <= ECDF; tied values receive the same percentile

feature.missing_member_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED; any missing, stale, non-finite, or source-unverified member blocks the entire daily state. No partial-panel aggregation, zero-fill, interpolation, or forward-fill.
feature.source_identity: BINANCE_USDM_FUNDING_SETTLEMENT_MATERIALIZER_V0; data.binance.vision monthly fundingRate archive is causal source, official fapi fundingRate REST is exact coverage witness; archive/checksum/raw-byte identities must be retained.
feature.formula: pressure_t = median_i(abs(rate_i(e_i))), where e_i=max{e: funding_time_i(e) <= t and t-24h < funding_time_i(e)}; percentile_t = count(v <= pressure_t) / count(v) over v = prior 365 daily pressure observations plus pressure_t; state_t = percentile_t.

outcome.market_return_definition: For each completed hourly close interval, compute each panel member's simple close-to-close return; market return is the equal-weight arithmetic mean across all 20 members.
outcome.panel: The same frozen 20-member panel as FUNDING_PRESSURE; no universe change or current-listing substitution.
outcome.forward_horizon: Exactly 24 completed hourly intervals after the daily 00:00:00Z decision timestamp.
outcome.realized_volatility_estimator: sqrt(mean(market_return_{t+1:t+24}^2)); zero mean correction; no annualization.
outcome.minimum_observations: 24 hourly market returns, each with 20/20 valid member closes.
outcome.missingness: FAIL_CLOSED; any missing/non-finite/non-positive close or incomplete member return blocks the outcome label. No gap bridging.
outcome.timestamp_alignment: Feature decision uses information through t. Outcome uses closes strictly after t through t+24h; label becomes observable only after t+24h.
outcome.overlap_policy: Daily 00:00Z decisions and 24-hour labels are non-overlapping; no overlapping forward labels.

primary_proposition: HIGH FUNDING_PRESSURE predicts HIGHER subsequent 24-hour FUTURE_MARKET_WIDE_REALIZED_VOLATILITY: HIGH minus LOW mean RV24 > 0.
primary_statistic: mean(RV24 | HIGH) - mean(RV24 | LOW), one signed contrast only.
execution_boundary: No execution, outcome calculation, statistical test, threshold search, robustness search, or protected Breadth access is authorized by this preregistration.
execution_gate: BLOCKED_UNTIL_CERTIFIED_20_OF_20_FUNDING_AND_OHLCV_PIT_COVERAGE; THIS COMMIT FREEZES THE CONTRACT ONLY

literature_adjudication.claim: Perpetual funding is a periodic transfer intended to keep perpetual and spot prices aligned.
literature_adjudication.source: He, Manela, Ross & von Wachter, Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures (2022).

literature_adjudication.claim: Funding-rule intervals, caps, clamps, and crisis dynamics can affect funding tails and basis volatility.
literature_adjudication.source: Zhang, Funding Rate Mechanism in Perpetual Futures (2026 working paper).

literature_adjudication.claim: Absolute perpetual basis has been reported as a forward-volatility predictor in a separate study.
literature_adjudication.source: Lim, The Information Content of Perpetual Basis (2026 working paper).

literature_adjudication.claim: Funding-rate extremeness is a defensible stress proxy for this design, while direction alone is not mechanically compelled to predict volatility; this is an inference, not a published funding-rate result.
literature_adjudication.source: Mechanism synthesis above; basis is not substituted for funding.

literature_adjudication.claim: Whether Binance settlement-rate magnitude predicts QntyLab's frozen market-wide RV24 is unresolved until a separately executed experiment.
